name: Sysvora GST Invoice – GSTR-1 Export, HSN & Pincode Checker for WooCommerce
author: sysvora

sections.description:
Sysvora GST Invoice creates GST invoices for WooCommerce stores in India. It splits GST into CGST, SGST and IGST, prints HSN/SAC codes, exports your monthly GSTR-1 data (B2B, B2CS and HSN summary) as CSV files, collects the buyer’s GSTIN at checkout and lets shoppers check delivery to their pincode.

Every feature is included free: no locked options, no upsell nags and no external services. HPOS compatible and works with the block checkout.

Who it is for

  • Indian stores that need a WooCommerce GST invoice for each paid order.
  • Stores that sell to businesses and need the customer’s GSTIN on the tax invoice.
  • Stores (and their CAs) who want the month’s GSTR-1 B2B, B2CS and HSN summary without copying orders into a spreadsheet.
  • Stores that price products inclusive of GST and have never set up WooCommerce taxes.
  • Stores that deliver only to some pincodes, or offer Cash on Delivery only in some areas.

GST invoice for WooCommerce orders

  • Printable Tax Invoice for every paid order, with a Print / Save as PDF button.
  • Automatic CGST + SGST for sales within your state and IGST for sales to other states, based on the place of supply.
  • HSN/SAC code and GST rate per product. Both are optional: an empty field uses your default, and variations use the parent product’s values.
  • Works whether or not you use WooCommerce taxes:
    • If WooCommerce charged tax on the order, the invoice uses those exact amounts.
    • If you sell at GST-inclusive prices without WooCommerce taxes, the price is split into taxable value and GST using the product’s rate.
  • Shipping and fees shown with their own SAC code and GST rate.
  • Sequential invoice numbers such as INV/2026-27/0001, optionally restarting every financial year (1 April).
  • Amount in words using lakh and crore, round-off line, place of supply with state code, reverse charge declaration and signatory block.
  • Issued invoices are saved: editing a product, your settings or the order later does not change them.
  • Invoice button in the admin orders list, on the order screen, and for customers in My Account > Orders, plus an invoice link on the order confirmation page and in customer emails, so guests can open it too.
  • Orders in other currencies show their own currency. Exports can be marked as zero-rated under bond/LUT or on payment of IGST.
  • Not GST-registered? Leave the GSTIN empty and a plain invoice is issued.

GSTR-1 export (CSV)

  • WooCommerce > GSTR-1 Export: choose a month and download CSV files in the column layout of the GST offline tool.
  • B2B (table 4): one row per invoice and GST rate for buyers who entered a GSTIN, with invoice number, date, value, place of supply and taxable value.
  • B2CS (table 7): sales to consumers added up by place of supply and GST rate. Intra-state and inter-state sales are handled automatically.
  • HSN summary (table 12), split into B2B and B2C as on the GST portal: HSN, description, UQC, quantity, total value, rate, taxable value, IGST, CGST and SGST.
  • Uses the invoices exactly as they were issued, and only orders that are Processing or Completed. Cancelled, refunded and failed orders are left out.
  • Preview of the totals on screen, with notes for anything that needs your attention (B2CL invoices, exports, refunds, missing HSN codes).
  • Please check the files, or ask your CA to check them, before filing. B2CL, exports, credit notes and the JSON file are not created.

GSTIN field at WooCommerce checkout

  • Optional Business name and GSTIN fields for B2B buyers, in both the block checkout and the classic checkout.
  • GSTIN format and check digit are validated, so typing mistakes are caught before the order is placed.
  • Shown on the invoice, the order confirmation page, My Account, the admin order screen and order emails.

Pincode delivery checker for WooCommerce

  • “Check delivery to your pincode” box on product pages, or anywhere with the [sysvora_gst_pincode_checker] shortcode.
  • Define serviceable areas with exact pincodes, ranges (395001-395099) or prefixes (395*), each with an optional delivery time.
  • Mark areas as no-cod to hide Cash on Delivery for those pincodes at checkout.
  • Optionally block checkout to pincodes you do not deliver to.
  • Remembers the shopper’s pincode on their device.

Built for quality

  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the Cart and Checkout blocks.
  • No external API calls, no tracking, no ads, no upsell nags.
  • After 10 invoices, shop managers see one polite request for a review, which can be snoozed or hidden for good.
  • Translation ready.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install Sysvora GST Invoice from Plugins > Add New, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Make sure your store country is India and your state is set in WooCommerce > Settings > General.
  5. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Sysvora GST Invoice, enter your legal business name and GSTIN, and choose a default GST rate and HSN/SAC code.
  6. Optionally set an HSN/SAC code and GST rate on each product (Product data > General).
  7. To use the pincode checker, open the Pincode checker section, enable it and add your serviceable pincodes.
  8. At the start of each month, open WooCommerce > GSTR-1 Export to download last month’s GSTR-1 CSV files.
sections.faq:
How do I add a GST invoice in WooCommerce?

Install the plugin, set your store country to India and choose your state in WooCommerce > Settings > General, then enter your business name and GSTIN in WooCommerce > Settings > Sysvora GST Invoice. The invoice button then appears on Processing and Completed orders.

Do I need to set up WooCommerce taxes first?

No. If you sell at GST-inclusive prices, set the GST rate on each product, or one default rate, and the invoice splits the price for you. If you already use WooCommerce taxes, the invoice uses the tax charged on the order.

Which GST rates can I choose?

0%, 0.1%, 0.25%, 1.5%, 3%, 5%, 12%, 18%, 28% and 40%. Developers can change the list with the sysvora_gst_gst_rates filter.

Is the HSN code compulsory for every product?

The plugin does not force it. Leave the field empty to use your default HSN/SAC code.

How is CGST/SGST vs IGST decided?

The place of supply is the shipping state (or the billing state if the order has no shipping address). If it is the same as your store state, the GST is split into CGST and SGST/UTGST. When the tax is an odd number of paise the two differ by 1 paisa, unless you turn on Equal CGST and SGST in the settings. Otherwise IGST is charged. Orders shipped outside India are marked as exports, and you choose in the settings whether they include IGST or are zero-rated under bond/LUT.

My prices already include GST and I have not set up WooCommerce taxes. Will the invoice be correct?

Yes. When WooCommerce did not charge tax on an order, the amount paid is treated as GST-inclusive and split into taxable value and GST using each product’s GST rate. The invoice total always matches the order total; any rounding difference is shown as a round-off line.

Can I download the invoice as a PDF?

Yes, using your browser. Open the invoice and click Print / Save as PDF, then choose “Save as PDF” as the printer. The invoice is formatted for A4 paper.

Can guest customers open their invoice?

Yes. The order confirmation page and the customer emails contain a private invoice link that works without an account. Anyone who has the link can open that invoice. You can turn the links off in the settings.

I edited an order after the invoice was issued. How do I update the invoice?

Open the order, choose Update GST invoice from current order details under Order actions and click the arrow. The invoice number and date stay the same and an order note is added. Please check with your tax adviser whether a changed invoice needs a credit or debit note instead.

Does it create credit notes or handle refunds?

Not yet. The invoice shows the original order.

When is the invoice number assigned?

When the order first becomes Processing or Completed. Numbers are never reused, even if the plugin is deleted and installed again.

Does it work with the block checkout?

Yes. The GSTIN fields use the official WooCommerce Additional Checkout Fields API, and the pincode rules are enforced for both block and classic checkout.

How do I export GSTR-1 from WooCommerce?

Go to WooCommerce > GSTR-1 Export, choose the month and click the B2B, B2CS or HSN summary button. Each CSV file uses the columns of the matching section in the GST offline tool, so you can import it there, check it and upload the return. Please verify the figures yourself or with your CA before filing.

Which orders are included in the GSTR-1 export?

Invoices dated in the chosen month from orders that are Processing or Completed. Cancelled, refunded, failed, pending and on-hold orders are left out. Amounts are taken from the invoice saved when it was issued, so later changes to products or settings do not alter them.

Does the GSTR-1 export cover B2CL, exports and credit notes?

No. Inter-state invoices to consumers above Rs 1,00,000 (B2CL) and exports are listed on the export page so you can enter them yourself; they are left out of the B2CS file but are counted in the HSN summary. Credit notes, nil-rated supplies and the JSON file are not created.

Does the plugin file GST returns or generate e-invoices (IRN)?

No. It creates GST tax invoices and GSTR-1 CSV files that you import into the GST offline tool. Filing the return and e-invoicing through the GST portal are done by you or your CA.

Is it compatible with HPOS?

Yes. It supports WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage and the older posts storage, and is tested with both.

Can I change the invoice design?

Yes. Copy templates/invoice.php into your theme and point to it with the sysvora_gst_invoice_template filter.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • New: GSTR-1 export under WooCommerce > GSTR-1 Export. Download B2B, B2CS and HSN summary (B2B and B2C) CSV files for any month, in the GST offline tool’s column layout, with an on-screen preview and notes.
  • New: setting for the unit (UQC) used for goods in the HSN summary.
  • New: one dismissible review request for shop managers after 10 invoices (“Maybe later” or “Don’t show again”).
  • Changed: plugin name now mentions GSTR-1 export.

1.0.1

  • Fixed: invoices are saved when the number is assigned, so later changes to products, settings or orders no longer alter them. Existing invoices are saved the first time they are opened.
  • Fixed: guests can open their invoice through a private link on the order confirmation page and in customer emails.
  • Fixed: orders in other currencies no longer show INR and Rupees.
  • Fixed: GST rates from WooCommerce taxes show the real percentage (18% instead of 17.99%).
  • Fixed: numbers with {FY} use the short year (26-27) when they would be longer than 16 characters, and the settings warn about formats that break the GST rules.
  • New: optional export declaration and zero-rating under bond/LUT.
  • New: optional equal CGST and SGST amounts.
  • New: order action to update an invoice from the current order.

1.0.0

  • First release: GST tax invoices, HSN/SAC and GST rate per product, customer GSTIN at checkout, pincode delivery checker with COD control.
